📣 Lancashire residents: you've got until Wednesday 2 December to have your say on the County Council's budget.

💷 The council needs around £79 million of savings for 2027/28, even if council tax rises by the maximum 4.99%.

I want to hear from as many of you as possible: what matters most, what should be protected, and where you think money is wasted. It takes five minutes. Search 'Planning the council's budget' on the Lancashire County Council website. 🗳️
